Lit and waving. The flicker goes by too fast to read, so I'm stretching the warm-up a little.

The title "Tim's Robot Internet Fixer" is now a hot-pink neon sign. I added a new mod, **Neon Title**.

- **On startup:** the title starts out as dark, faint pink glass. After a moment it flickers on and off a few times over about 2½ seconds, then comes on for good at full glow.
- **After that:** the glow hums very slightly, and the "o" in "Robot" is a faulty tube that sputters out for a split second every 7 seconds or so.
- **Wave:** each letter bobs up and down in turn, so a wave rolls across the title from left to right. Words stay together, and screen readers still read it as one title.
- **Reduced motion:** if your system asks for less motion, the title just glows steadily, with no flicker or wave.

**What I checked:** after a reload the title started unlit and finished lit, the letter heights showed the wave travelling across it, and the screenshot looks right. No errors.

To undo it, switch off **Neon Title** in the side panel, or ask me to.
